answer.text: Shares/units held > 12 months AND STT paid on purchase/sale for equity (sale for MF units)
Stock held for less than 12 months

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.3, Section 112A applies to LTCG on listed equity/MF units/business trust units where STT is paid appropriately and held > 12 months. The Trap: Other requirements don't match Section 112A. Cross-Exam Context: Core conditions for concessional LTCG rate. Distributor's Pro-Tip: If no STT, Section 112A cannot be claimed — check each sale's STT payment.
